name: Chram Snowel
original_name: クラム・スノーウェル
source:
Headmaster of the Hidden Eyes Private School. Looks like a foreigner and frequently talks about his home country, but no one knows which country that is. He’s a good-natured and friendly person, but can be annoying as he tries to associate with everyone regardless of who they are. He’s too pure to handle, and so he’s said to be the most problematic person in the school.

‘Youth is the springtime of life, after all.’
‘Why is that~?! Didn’t you just say that you like me too~?!’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
